issue: New entry does not persist across page reload
actual: Added entry 'Test Entry FT1' with all field values via Add Entry dialog; it appeared immediately (6 entries). After navigating/reloading the app URL, the entry list reverted to the original 5 seed entries; 'Test Entry FT1' and the previously added 'Notes' field were both gone, and count showed '5 entries'.
evidence: Pre-reload: statusbar.count='6 entries', includes entry-1787683230782-v8zx9kq97. Post-reload semantic_snapshot: statusbar.count='5 entries', only entry-1..entry-5 present, Notes field/header absent.

Opened Fields dialog, added field 'Notes' (Text type) via new-field name input + Add button. New field appeared in fields.dialog.list, in entry.dialog.fields (Add Entry form), in table header (entries.table.header.field-1787683211500-rf9rur08w) and in card view itemControls.

Created entry with Task Name='Test Entry FT1' (text), Priority=42 (number), Due Date=2026-09-01 (date), Completed=true (checkbox), Notes='Sample note' (text). All values correctly displayed in table (42, Sep 1, 2026, check icon, Sample note) and card view (42, Sep 1, 2026, 'Yes', Sample note).
Switched Table→Cards: same 6 entries with identical field values shown in both entries.table and entries.cards collections; no data loss or alteration.

In Cards view, sorted by Task Name asc then desc via toolbar.sort menu - order changed correctly each time, statusbar showed 'Sorted by Task Name (ascending/descending)'. Switched to Table view: sort reset to 'Sort' (no active field), then sorted Table by Priority (ascending) via column header. Switched back to Cards: retained its own 'Task Name (descending)' sort untouched by Table's Priority sort - confirming independent per-view sort state.

actual: No filter UI control exists anywhere in the app. semantic_snapshot (including hidden elements) shows no filter action/input, and a DOM-wide search (browser_evaluate) for any element with 'filter' in attributes, class name, or text content returned zero matches.

evidence: With sort cleared, used drag-handle keyboard reordering (focus handle, Space to pick up, ArrowDown, Space to drop) in Cards view: entry-1 moved to a new position, order became entry-2,3,4,5,1,new. Then in Table view (sort cleared) reordered entry-1 down one slot: entry-2,1,3,4,5,new. Switching back to Cards confirmed it retained its own manual order (entry-2,3,4,5,1,new), independent of Table's order (entry-2,1,3,4,5,new). Entry count and values unchanged throughout.

actual: No import button/control found anywhere in the app, including the 'Configure Fields' dialog which only contains field name/type editors and an 'Add' field control. A DOM-wide search for any element with 'import' in text/attributes returned zero matches, despite the dialog's note text: 'Configure fields before importing data.'

evidence: Priority field in Add Entry form is a native HTML input[type=number] (spinbutton). Attempting to type 'abc' into it via Playwright failed with 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]', confirming the browser-level type constraint prevents non-numeric entry; valid numeric value 42 was accepted and saved correctly.

Due Date field is a native input[type=date]. Programmatically setting an invalid date string '2026-13-45' resulted in the input value being rejected/cleared to '' (validity.valid=true, value=''), confirming invalid dates cannot be set. Valid date 2026-09-01 was accepted and displayed correctly as 'Sep 1, 2026'.

Before and after sorting by Task Name/Priority (asc/desc), entry count remained '6 entries' and each entry's field-2/field-3/field-4/Notes values were identical to pre-sort values in the folded collection listing - only row order changed.

issue: No filter feature implemented, so filter criteria/behavior cannot be exercised
actual: Same as FT-6: no filter control exists in the UI or DOM, so entries cannot be filtered by field criteria at all.

evidence: All 6 entries and their field-2/field-3/field-4/Notes values matched exactly between entries.table and entries.cards collections. Empty Notes value for original 5 entries displayed as '—' consistently in both table cell and card field.

Field config dialog shows clearly labeled type options: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox (select options with those exact labels). Entry form provides type-appropriate controls: text input for Task Name/Notes, native number spinbutton for Priority, native date picker input for Due Date, and a checkbox toggle with 'Completed'/'No'/'Yes' label for Completed.

Table view: checked entries render a green 'lucide-check' icon (class 'text-success'), unchecked entries render a gray 'lucide-x' icon (class 'text-muted-foreground') - clearly distinguishable via icon shape and color. Card view: checked shows text 'Yes', unchecked shows 'No'. Entry form uses a native checkbox with 'Yes'/'No' label reflecting state.

issue: Quick search matches internal raw field values instead of the formatted/displayed values
actual: Searching 'Jan 18' (the displayed formatted date for entry-2's Due Date, shown as 'Jan 18, 2026') returned '0 entries matching'. Searching the raw ISO value '2026-01-18' (never shown to the user) correctly matched entry-2. Searching 'Yes' (the displayed Completed value in card view) also returned '0 entries matching' despite 3 entries showing 'Yes'.

evidence: Typed lowercase 'review' into search box; it matched 'Review marketing materials' (case-insensitive substring), statusbar updated to '1 entry matching \"review\"'. Clicking clear-search restored all 6 entries with count 'entries.count'=6 and previous manual order preserved.

Selecting 'Task Name' from the Sort menu immediately reordered visible entries alphabetically ascending, and statusbar.sort displayed 'Sorted by Task Name (ascending)'. Re-selecting toggled to 'Sorted by Task Name (descending)' with entries re-ordered accordingly. Toolbar remained interactive throughout (view switch, add entry, search all still functioned).
